text:
ashley_sales: Jon's demo just hit SSE disconnects during long summaries. UI shows "Unexpected end of event". Can we triage quickly?

ben_eng: on it. any client logs or raw fragments?

jon_prospect: copied network payload:
``n
data: {"chunk": "Hello, this is a long response that continues but then gets"}


data: {"chunk": "truncat..."}

``nConnection closed after partial utf8 sequence.

carmen_sre: checking edge logs for 1830000000-1830000050. I see a 502 and a TCP FIN on the backend for that stream. Also proxy_buffering appears enabled for the vhost.

ben_eng: two quick mitigations: 1) disable proxy buffering and gzip for the POC host (`X-Accel-Buffering: no`) and 2) force flush after each event. Simple Node example: `res.write('data: '+json+'\n\n'); if (res.flush) res.flush();`

carmen_sre: infra canary: turning off buffering for poc-jon-1 for 15m.

deploy_bot: canary-change: nginx `proxy_buffering off` applied to poc-jon-1 at 1830000045.

jon_prospect: retested — looks better, no parse error across 3 runs. Thanks.

ben_eng: follow-up: we'll add small chunk sizing (256B) and id fields so clients can resume using `Last-Event-ID`. Also recommend client tolerate partial bytes by buffering until full `\n\n` event boundary.

ashley_sales: great — I'll send Jon the SOC2 packet and ballpark Dedicated pricing after we capture avg concurrent streams.

carmen_sre: leaving canary in place for 30m and monitoring for any 5xxs.

ashley_sales: thanks team!
